headline: Understand Your Body, Every Single Day
body: Take the guesswork out of daily movement. The FitTrack Band features reliable step tracking, comprehensive sleep tracking, and continuous activity monitoring to give you a clear picture of how you move and rest throughout the day.
explanation: Variant 2 is selected as the winning variant because it strictly adheres to all brand rules. It features no superlatives, no unsupported claims, accurately highlights the provided product features (step tracking, sleep tracking, activity monitoring), and includes a strong, clear call to action tailored to the target audience.
compliance_checks: Includes a clear call to action
